package.description: Transform your big screen into a universal screen mirroring receiver.

en-US.description: Transform your big screen into a universal screen mirroring receiver.
en-US.longDescription: AirServer transforms a simple display or a projector into a universal screen mirroring receiver. It does this by implementing all the major screen mirroring technologies such as AirPlay, Google Cast and Miracast into one screen mirroring receiver. With AirServer enabled on your big screen, users can use their devices such as an iPhone, iPad, Mac, Android, Nexus, Pixel, Chromebook, or a Windows 10 PC to wirelessly mirror their display over to the big screen, instantly turning the room into a collaborative space.
en-US.name: AirServer Universal

zh-CN.description: 将您的大屏幕转变为通用的投屏接收器。
zh-CN.longDescription: AirServer 可将一个简单的显示器或投影仪转变成一个通用的投屏接收器。它将 AirPlay、Google Cast 和 Miracast 等所有主要投屏技术整合到一个投屏接收器中。在大屏幕上启用 AirServer 后，用户可以使用 iPhone、iPad、Mac、Android、Nexus、Pixel、Chromebook 或 Windows 10 PC 等设备将自己的显示屏无线镜像到大屏幕上，瞬间将房间变成一个协作空间。
